about.heading: About RoEstate
about.heroSub: Your trusted partner for real estate in Romania since 2009

story.heading: Our Story
story.p1: RoEstate was founded in 2009 by a team of cross-border real estate professionals who recognised a growing need for transparent, multilingual property consultancy in Romania. As the country attracted increasing interest from international buyers and investors, we built a service that bridges cultures and simplifies complexity.
story.p2: Today, our team of specialist consultants serves clients from over 20 countries, helping them buy, sell, and invest across Bucharest, Cluj-Napoca, Brașov, Constanța, and beyond. We are proud to be one of the few agencies in Romania operating in English, Romanian, Turkish, and Arabic — removing language barriers so that every client feels at home.
story.p3: We believe that finding the right property should be an exciting journey, not a stressful one. That is why we provide full-service support from initial search to final signature, including legal guidance, notary coordination, and post-purchase assistance.

eu.title: EU Member State
eu.desc: Romania is a full EU member, offering legal security, property rights protections, and access to EU frameworks for buyers from any country.

foreign.title: Open to Foreign Buyers
foreign.desc: EU nationals may purchase property freely. Non-EU nationals can own apartments and commercial property; land ownership is available via a Romanian-registered company.

growth.title: Growing Urban Markets
growth.desc: Bucharest and Cluj-Napoca are among Central Europe's fastest-growing cities, driven by a thriving tech sector and rising household incomes.

lifestyle.title: Quality of Life
lifestyle.desc: Romania offers a rich cultural heritage, beautiful landscapes, excellent cuisine, and a cost of living that remains affordable by Western European standards.
